name: The Gun That Never Lets You Down

description.value:
Requirement A named weapon (Name the Gun) or a bonded Good Gun you have carried since at least 14th level.

The weapon becomes yours in a way that is no longer strictly mechanical. It never fails, never breaks, cannot be destroyed by any effect that allows a save, and returns to your hand at the start of each day no matter where it was left. If it is a scrap gun it counts as a Good Gun from now on for every purpose on this page — the only way one is ever made rather than found.

cinderfall.incomplete: ("never fails" ties to Failure Range/Gun Failure) + same unresolved Immunity-to-maneuver-class issue as name-the-gun ("can't be destroyed by any effect that allows a save") + no selector for a daily item-relocation effect (confirmed absent per the assignment's pre-confirmed list: "no rule element creates/relocates a specific item back into inventory after a time delay"). This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
